title: Efficient quantum state tomography with two complementary projective measurements
summary: Quantum state tomography (QST) is of fundamental importance to characterize quantum systems in quantum information processing, but its practical implementation is severely hindered by the exponential scaling of measurement and computational costs. In this paper, we present a novel QST protocol that utilizes Kirkwood-Dirac (KD) quasiprobability to reconstruct quantum states. First, it enables state reconstruction with only two complementary rank-one projective measurements, thus significantly reducing the measurement cost.
